task: Write a short team message with these seven constraints: (1) 66 to 70 words inclusive; a word is a match of [A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?, so punctuation is not a word. (2) Include the whole word "copper" ignoring case. (3) Do not use the whole word "perfect" ignoring case. (4) No digits. (5) Exactly 2 nonempty paragraphs separated by a blank line. (6) Begin exactly "Dear team,". (7) End exactly "Kind regards.".
